hotels.title: Contemporary Pullman Hai Phong Stay with Rooftop Pool & Six Restaurants & Bars
hotels.description: Discover Hai Phong’s vibrant pulse from the sleek comfort of Pullman’s urban oasis. Ideally located on Tran Phu Street, the hotel offers modern luxury with sweeping views of the Cam River. Enjoy access to a serene rooftop pool and state-of-the-art wellness facilities, including a relaxing spa and fitness centre. Indulge in reimagined Cantonese classics at Red Flowers Pavilion, or savour premium meat cooked over charcoal and fresh seafood with panoramic views at Mad Cow Wine & Grill. Pullman places you at the heart of Hai Phong’s rich cultural and culinary scene - with access to Hanoi, Ha Long Bay and Cat Ba Island for unforgettable day trips.
